name: W Bogota Hotel
positioning: W Bogota in the Usaquen neighborhood, with design built around the El Dorado legend, an AWAY Spa with a hydrotherapy pool and gilded mosaics, and music-led touches like an in-room vinyl menu
best_for: Design and music lovers who want a hotel with a strong sense of Colombian myth and culture
Spa-goers who want a hydrotherapy pool and treatments using local botanicals
Travelers using Bogota as a base for day trips to Guatavita or Zipaquira

facts.text: The hotel is in the Usaquen neighborhood, near embassies, restaurants and boutiques.
Spa therapies use local botanical products crafted exclusively for the hotel from plant extracts.
Spa therapists blend the prescribed essential oils in a shaker for each treatment.
The spa has a hydrotherapy pool and separate male and female steam rooms.
Every Thursday, W Lounge hosts Living Room Sessions featuring Colombian talent.
Guests can take a guided craft beer or coffee tasting.
The Whatever/Whenever service can arrange guided tours of Usaquen and day trips to the Guatavita Lagoon or the Salt Cathedral of Zipaquira.
Jairo Restaurant is a tribute to Colombian farmers, transforming daily market products with modern fusion cuisine.
Guest rooms and suites are open-plan with vibrant decor and floor-to-ceiling windows.
The presidential suite has a circular sofa, floral tapestry and a sitting area.
The Salon offers beauty and grooming services for men and women, including precision cuts, blowouts and beard sculpting.
Usaquen has colonial-style buildings and local jewelry and crafts.

highlights.text: AWAY Spa's decor, inspired by the El Dorado legend, mixes gilded abstract mosaics, emerald green hues and sculptural ceilings.
The hotel's design draws on the ancient legend of El Dorado, with a glittery golden atmosphere.
An In-Room Vinyl Menu, made with Sony Music, is available in all rooms, with vinyl records and cocktails inspired by each artist.
The FIT gym on the fourth floor overlooks Bogota's skyline through oversized windows.
The W Lounge design joins Bogota's famous graffiti with golden threads, evoking the El Dorado legend at Guatavita lake.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
The garage has a 2-meter height restriction.
El Dorado International Airport is about 18 kilometers from the hotel.
